# visual access

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:facetVisual`](gmeow-facetVisual.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/facetVisual>
- **Category:** individual
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/accessibility`](../../slices/accessibility.md)
- **Box roles:** [ABox role](../boxes/abox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Access for people with visual impairments — tactile paving, audio signals, high contrast, braille.

## Structure
